transfers.recommended: AREX Non-Stop Express Train (43 min to T1, 51 min to T2) with Seoul Station City Airport Terminal check-in if eligible.

days.title: Serene Landing & Heritage Haven Check-in
days.anchor: ICN arrival at 21:00 → late transfer → peaceful hotel check-in → restorative rest

schedule.title: Direct Transfer to Central Seoul Heritage Base
schedule.detail: Direct Airport Limousine Bus or official taxi to Myeongdong / Seoul Station hotel.

schedule.title: Hotel Check-in & Peaceful Rest
schedule.detail: Settle into hotel room with warm herbal tea; rest deeply before Joseon palace exploration.

blocks.label: Gentle Start
blocks.text: Preserve energy for extensive walking through historic palace courtyards and stone pathways.

blocks.label: Historic Base
blocks.text: Base provides effortless walking access to Deoksugung and Royal Palaces.

days.food: Light herbal tea and convenience store snack near hotel.
days.reservationNote: Confirm late check-in with hotel in writing.
days.costNote: Limousine Bus ~₩17,000.
days.watchouts: Get deep sleep to prepare for morning palace ceremonies.

days.title: Royal Court Architecture & Traditional Hanok Living
days.anchor: Gyeongbokgung Palace Guard Changing → National Palace Museum → Bukchon Hanok Craft Workshops

schedule.title: Gyeongbokgung Royal Palace & Guard Ceremony
schedule.detail: Observe the colorful Royal Guard Changing Ceremony at Gwanghwamun Gate (10:00 AM) and study the intricate dancheong woodwork of Geunjeongjeon throne hall and Hyangwonjeong island pavilion.

schedule.title: National Palace Museum of Korea
schedule.detail: Examine royal Joseon seals, astronomical water clocks (Jagyeongnu), court attire, and imperial palanquins.
schedule.logistics: Located directly inside palace south gate (free admission).

schedule.title: Samcheong-dong Royal Court Lunch
schedule.detail: Enjoy refined dolsot bibimbap or handmade dumplings in a quiet Samcheong-dong courtyard.

schedule.title: Bukchon Hanok Village & Traditional Craft Centers
schedule.detail: Explore centuries-old wooden hanok architecture and visit artisanal workshops for Korean knotting (maedeup) and mother-of-pearl lacquerware (najeonchilgi).

schedule.title: Insadong Antique Gallery & Traditional Teahouse
schedule.detail: Browse Joseon celadon ceramics, calligraphy brushes, and sip hot omija tea in a 100-year-old wooden hanok teahouse.

schedule.title: Traditional Hanjeongsik (Korean Full-Course) Dinner
schedule.detail: Savor a multi-course royal court dinner with braised short ribs, grilled fish, seasoned mountain herbs, and steamed rice.

blocks.label: Royal Court Immersion
blocks.text: Combines primary Joseon seat of power with living royal museum artifacts and artisan workshops.

blocks.label: Preserved Aesthetics
blocks.text: Bukchon and Insadong showcase traditional Korean architectural balance with nature (Pungsu-jiri).

days.food: Lunch: Samcheong-dong handmade dumplings and bibimbap. Afternoon: Traditional pine needle tea and yakgwa. Dinner: Insadong Royal Hanjeongsik multi-course banquet.
days.reservationNote: Palace admission ₩3,000 (free if wearing traditional hanbok).
days.costNote: Palace entry ₩3,000; Hanjeongsik dinner ~₩38,000 per person.
days.watchouts: Bukchon is a quiet residential area; speak in low tones and observe residential privacy.
days.planB: National Palace Museum is fully indoor and climate-controlled.

days.title: Sacred Royal Groves & Ancestral Ceremonial Shrines
days.anchor: Changdeokgung Secret Garden (UNESCO) → Jongmyo Royal Ancestral Shrine → Ikseon Hanok Alleys

schedule.title: Changdeokgung Palace & Secret Garden (Huwon)
schedule.detail: Tour the UNESCO World Heritage palace, designed in complete harmony with surrounding natural topography, and walk the private royal autumn garden.

schedule.title: Ikseon-dong Hanok Brunch
schedule.detail: Dine on handmade pasta or Korean rice sets in a restored 1920s hanok courtyard.

schedule.title: Jongmyo Royal Ancestral Shrine (UNESCO)
schedule.detail: Walk the world's longest wooden structure (Jeongjeon), dedicated to memorial services for Joseon kings and queens and home to the 600-year-old Jongmyo Jeryeak ritual music tradition.

schedule.title: Changgyeonggung Palace & Grand Greenhouse
schedule.detail: Stroll the picturesque autumn gardens and Korea's first Western-style royal greenhouse built in 1909.

schedule.title: Jongno Traditional Braised Beef (Galbijjim) Dinner
schedule.detail: Savor slow-braised beef short ribs tenderly cooked in sweet soy sauce with chestnuts, gingko nuts, and carrots.

blocks.label: Double UNESCO Heritage
blocks.text: Changdeokgung and Jongmyo represent the spiritual and architectural zenith of the Joseon Dynasty.

blocks.label: Autumn Forest Foliage
blocks.text: The Secret Garden and Changgyeonggung forest offer some of Seoul's most breathtaking autumn maple colors.

days.food: Lunch: Ikseon-dong hanok courtyard dining. Dinner: Jongno slow-cooked Hanwoo Galbijjim (braised beef short ribs) with warm rice.
days.reservationNote: Book Changdeokgung Secret Garden timed tour online 6 days in advance at 10:00 AM KST.
days.costNote: Changdeokgung + Huwon ₩8,000; Jongmyo ₩1,000; Changgyeonggung ₩1,000.
days.watchouts: Jongmyo stone pathways (Sindo) are sacred for ancestral spirits; walk on side stones rather than center.
days.planB: Palace exhibition halls and greenhouse provide shelter.

days.title: Fine Contemporary Visions & Romantic Stonewall Alleys
days.anchor: MMCA Seoul (Contemporary Art) → Deoksugung Palace & Stonewall Walkway → Jeongdong Heritage

schedule.title: MMCA Seoul (National Museum of Modern & Contemporary Art)
schedule.detail: Explore groundbreaking exhibitions of contemporary Korean artists, monumental sculpture installations, and the historic Jongchinbu royal genealogy office on museum grounds.

schedule.title: Samcheong-dong Fine Dining Lunch
schedule.detail: Enjoy refined seasonal Korean dining or garden cafe lunch.

schedule.title: Deoksugung Palace & MMCA Deoksugung Branch
schedule.detail: Tour the unique palace blending Joseon wooden pavilions with neoclassical Western stone architecture (Seokjojeon).

schedule.title: Deoksugung Stonewall Walkway & Jeongdong Heritage Trail
schedule.detail: Walk Korea's most romantic tree-lined stonewall road, viewing historic 19th-century diplomatic legations, and take the elevator up to Jeongdong Observatory for sunset views.

schedule.title: Gwanghwamun Hanwoo Bulgogi Dinner
schedule.detail: Enjoy seasoned Korean beef bulgogi with glass noodles and organic mushrooms in a quiet private dining room.

blocks.label: Art & History Synergy
blocks.text: Connects Korea's foremost contemporary museum (MMCA Seoul) with 20th-century modernization history at Deoksugung.

blocks.label: Romantic Urban Walk
blocks.text: Deoksugung Stonewall Walkway is draped in golden autumn ginkgo leaves throughout November.

days.food: Lunch: Samcheong-dong artisan Korean dining. Afternoon: Jeongdong Observatory Darak cafe. Dinner: Gwanghwamun Hanwoo beef bulgogi hot pot.
days.reservationNote: MMCA Seoul admission ₩5,000; Deoksugung Palace ₩1,000; Jeongdong Observatory is free.
days.costNote: Museums ~₩6,000; Dinner ~₩32,000 per person.
days.watchouts: MMCA Seoul and MMCA Deoksugung have separate ticket desks; verify current special exhibitions.
days.planB: MMCA and Seokjojeon are fully indoor fine art facilities.

days.title: Masterpiece Treasures & 5,000 Years of Artifacts

schedule.detail: Contemplate the two National Treasure Pensive Bodhisattva statues in the award-winning Room of Quiet Contemplation; marvel at the Ten-Story Gyeongcheonsa Pagoda, Silla golden crowns, and Goryeo celadon masterpieces.
schedule.logistics: Ichon Station Line 4 direct underground museum walkway.

schedule.title: Museum Mirror Pond Restaurant Lunch
schedule.detail: Dine overlooking the traditional pavilion and scenic reflection pond.

schedule.title: National Hangeul Museum
schedule.detail: Explore the scientific genius and cultural evolution of King Sejong's Korean alphabet (Hangeul) created in 1443.

schedule.title: Yongsan Family Park Autumn Stroll
schedule.detail: Relax along scenic tree-lined walking tracks and tranquil lotus ponds.

schedule.title: Samgakji Charcoal Hanwoo Ribs (Chadolbagi) Dinner
schedule.detail: Enjoy thinly sliced beef brisket and aged kimchi stew at historic Bongsan-jip.

blocks.label: Philosophical Wonder
blocks.text: The Room of Quiet Contemplation offers one of the world's most serene and transcendent museum spaces.

blocks.label: Hangeul Innovation
blocks.text: The Hangeul Museum illustrates how Korea's written language was designed for democratic literacy.

days.food: Lunch: National Museum Mirror Pond Korean set. Dinner: Samgakji Bongsan-jip Hanwoo beef brisket (chadolbagi) with spicy fermented cabbage stew.
days.reservationNote: National Museum of Korea permanent galleries are free admission.
days.costNote: Museum entry is free; Dinner ~₩35,000 per person.
days.watchouts: Photography inside Room of Quiet Contemplation is permitted without flash; maintain silence.
days.planB: National Museum of Korea is vast, heated, and completely indoor.

schedule.title: Hannam-dong Gourmet Lunch

schedule.title: Itaewon Antique Furniture Street

schedule.title: Namsan Outdoor Sculpture Park & Sunset

schedule.title: Traditional Ginseng Chicken Soup (Samgyetang) Dinner
schedule.detail: Warm up with whole young chicken stuffed with sticky rice, ginseng root, garlic, and jujubes simmered in rich herbal broth at Tosokchon.

blocks.label: Private Art Pinnacle
blocks.text: Leeum Museum offers Korea's most prestigious private art collection and stunning rotunda architecture.

blocks.label: Restorative Herbal Cuisine
blocks.text: Samgyetang restores warmth and vitality after a day of aesthetic discovery.

days.food: Lunch: Hannam-dong artisanal Italian or modern Korean bistro. Dinner: Tosokchon Samgyetang (historic ginseng chicken soup).

blocks.label: Vintage Discovery

itineraries.title: K-Innovation, High-Tech & Pop Culture Odyssey (Modern & Pop Culture)

itineraries.decisionSummary: A dynamic, trendsetting itinerary exploring Seoul's iconic esports arenas, K-pop busking streets, and Seongsu concept stores, alongside Daejeon's robotics superclusters and KAIST innovation labs, culminating in Busan's world-record cantilevered Cinema Center, drone spectacles, and immersive digital art museums.

itineraries.tradeoff: More focus on bustling commercial districts, high-tech venues, and nightlife than quiet countryside temples.

itineraries.title: Scenic Rail Corridor & Independence Heritage (Rail Classic Explorer)
itineraries.bestFor: Train lovers, history buffs, and practical travelers who appreciate ultra-fast 35-minute KTX rail transfers, majestic patriotic monuments, colossal bronze Buddhas, and scenic coastal railways.
itineraries.decisionSummary: An exceptionally efficient high-speed rail corridor connecting Seoul's imperial palaces and Suwon fortress with Cheonan's monumental Independence Hall and Damien Hirst sculpture park, concluding with Busan's beach trains and coastal cliffs.
itineraries.recommendation: Choose this route if you want maximum rail speed between cities (just 35 minutes Seoul to Cheonan), profound national independence heritage, and seamless transit logistics.
itineraries.tradeoff: Cheonan is a more compact, focused regional city with shorter transit times than Daejeon.

bases.why: Immediate access to Seoul Station for the short 35-minute KTX hop to Cheonan-Asan, direct AREX connection, and walking proximity to Deoksugung, Namdaemun, and Jongno.

budgetScenarios.note: Panoramic ocean views in Busan, premier bedding, luxury fitness, and central station ease.

bookingPriorities: Reconcile SFO outbound flight with Nov 1 21:00 local ICN arrival and Nov 22 13:00 departure.
Reserve 4 hotel base stays with free cancellation (Seoul 7N, Cheonan 5N, Busan 7N, Seoul 2N).
Book 3 KTX rail legs on Korail app 30 days prior (Seoul→Cheonan-Asan, Cheonan-Asan→Busan, Busan→Seoul).
Reserve AREX Non-Stop Airport Express tickets and pre-order Korea eSIM / T-Money / WOWPASS card.
Secure timed reservations for special experiences (e.g. Changdeokgung Secret Garden, Blueline Sky Capsule, Spa Land).

days.title: Smooth Late Arrival & Station-Adjacent Base Check-in
days.anchor: ICN arrival at 21:00 → late transfer → hotel check-in → restful sleep

schedule.title: ICN Arrival & Border Clearance
schedule.detail: Clear immigration smoothly, collect checked luggage, and pick up pre-arranged transportation card and eSIM.

schedule.title: Direct Transfer to Seoul Station Area
schedule.detail: Board Airport Limousine Bus or official taxi directly to Myeongdong / Seoul Station hotel.
schedule.logistics: Direct drop-off minimizes late-night subway transfers.

schedule.title: Hotel Check-in & Rest
schedule.detail: Check into hotel room, unpack essentials, hydrate, and get deep sleep.
schedule.logistics: Notify hotel in advance of late arrival.

blocks.label: Rail Anchor
blocks.text: Positioning at Seoul Station guarantees seamless train departures throughout the trip.

blocks.label: Arrival Protocol
blocks.text: Save energy for the comprehensive royal palace itinerary starting tomorrow morning.

days.food: Light convenience store snack (CU / GS25 warm samgak kimbap or banana milk).
days.reservationNote: Confirm late check-in with hotel in writing.
days.costNote: Limousine Bus ~₩17,000.
days.watchouts: Late night jetlag; keep bedtime calm without heavy alcohol.
days.planB: Official airport taxi stands are available outside terminal arrivals hall.

days.title: Imperial Grandeur & Traditional Hanok Quarters
days.anchor: Gyeongbokgung Palace Guard Changing → Bukchon Hanok Village → Insadong Teahouses

schedule.title: Gyeongbokgung Royal Palace
schedule.detail: Witness the Royal Guard Changing Ceremony at Gwanghwamun Gate (10:00 AM) and tour Geunjeongjeon throne hall and Gyeonghoeru Pavilion.

schedule.title: Samcheong-dong Traditional Lunch
schedule.detail: Savor handmade potato-dough sujebi or bulgogi along leafy Samcheong-dong.

schedule.title: Bukchon Hanok Village Walk
schedule.detail: Wander preserved Joseon residential stone alleys with traditional tile roofs overlooking modern Seoul.

schedule.title: Insadong Antique Street & Ssamzigil
schedule.detail: Browse traditional calligraphy, celadon crafts, and sip roasted jujube tea in a wooden hanok teahouse.

schedule.title: Welcome Korean BBQ Dinner
schedule.detail: Feast on charcoal-grilled pork belly with fresh lettuce wraps and doenjang stew.

blocks.label: Clustered Heritage
blocks.text: Gyeongbokgung, Bukchon, and Insadong are contiguous northern districts requiring zero subway hops during the day.

blocks.label: Autumn Ambience
blocks.text: Early November offers golden ginkgo foliage along Samcheong-dong and palace stone walls.

days.food: Lunch: Samcheong-dong Sujebi (Michelin Bib Gourmand). Dinner: Jongno charcoal-grilled pork belly with soybean stew.
days.reservationNote: Palace closed on Tuesdays; entry ₩3,000 (free if wearing hanbok).
days.costNote: Palace entry ₩3,000; meals ~₩35,000 per person.
days.watchouts: Bukchon is a quiet residential area; quiet hours strictly enforced after 17:00.
days.planB: National Folk Museum of Korea inside palace grounds provides covered indoor shelter.

days.title: Secret Royal Landscapes & Street Food Feasts
days.anchor: Changdeokgung Secret Garden (Huwon) → Ikseon-dong Hanok Cafes → Gwangjang Market

schedule.title: Changdeokgung Palace & Secret Garden (Huwon)
schedule.detail: Explore UNESCO World Heritage Changdeokgung and take a guided walking tour through the serene autumn Secret Garden pavilions.

schedule.title: Ikseon-dong Hanok Alleys & Lunch
schedule.detail: Discover retro-modern hanok alleys filled with artisanal bakeries and fusion cafes.

schedule.title: Jongmyo Royal Ancestral Shrine & Cheonggyecheon
schedule.detail: Walk the solemn grounds of Jongmyo Shrine and follow the tranquil Cheonggyecheon Stream pedestrian path.

schedule.title: Gwangjang Traditional Food Market
schedule.detail: Experience Korea's oldest market feast: crispy bindaetteok (mung bean pancake), mayak gimbap, and beef tartare (yukhoe).

blocks.label: Secret Garden Timing
blocks.text: Huwon requires advance timed reservation; early November autumn foliage here is world-famous.

blocks.label: Seamless Pedestrian Path
blocks.text: Connecting Changdeokgung through Ikseon-dong to Gwangjang Market is a straight, flat walk.

days.food: Lunch: Ikseon-dong hanok cafe dining. Dinner: Gwangjang Market bindaetteok, mayak gimbap, and makgeolli.
days.reservationNote: Book Changdeokgung Huwon Secret Garden ticket online 6 days in advance at 10:00 AM KST.
days.costNote: Palace + Garden entry ₩8,000; Market food ~₩20,000 per person.
days.watchouts: Gwangjang market food stalls are cash/T-money preferred.
days.planB: Gwangjang covered market roof shields from any autumn rain.

days.title: Masterpiece Artifacts & Mountain Skyline Panoramas
days.anchor: National Museum of Korea → War Memorial of Korea → N Seoul Tower Sunset

schedule.title: National Museum of Korea
schedule.detail: Marvel at Korean national treasures including the Pensive Bodhisattva in the Room of Quiet Contemplation and Ten-Story Gyeongcheonsa Pagoda.
schedule.logistics: Ichon Station Line 4 direct underground walkway.

schedule.title: Ichon-dong Gourmet Lunch
schedule.detail: Enjoy lunch in Little Tokyo Ichon-dong or museum garden cafe.

schedule.title: War Memorial of Korea
schedule.detail: Tour expansive outdoor military aircraft exhibitions and solemn indoor memorial halls.

schedule.title: N Seoul Tower & Namsan Sunset
schedule.detail: Ascend Namsan via scenic cable car or shuttle bus to enjoy 360-degree sunset views over Seoul.
schedule.logistics: Myeongdong Namsan Cable Car or Yellow Shuttle Bus #01.

schedule.title: Myeongdong Kyoja Dumpling Dinner
schedule.detail: Savor Michelin Bib Gourmand handmade pork dumplings and rich chicken broth kalguksu with spicy garlic kimchi.

blocks.label: Cultural Depth
blocks.text: National Museum provides essential historical context before traveling to regional Joseon and Silla cities.

blocks.label: Sunset Alignment
blocks.text: Reaching N Seoul Tower by 16:30 captures day, golden hour, and shimmering city lights.

days.food: Lunch: Ichon Japanese katsu or Museum Garden Cafe. Dinner: Myeongdong Kyoja (handmade kalguksu and steamed mandu).
days.reservationNote: National Museum permanent galleries are free admission.
days.costNote: N Seoul Tower observatory ₩21,000; Cable car round-trip ₩15,000.
days.watchouts: Cable car queue can be busy on clear evenings; shuttle bus 01 is faster alternative.
days.planB: National Museum of Korea is fully indoor and heated.

days.title: UNESCO Fortress Walls, Archery & King Galbi
days.anchor: Suwon Hwaseong Fortress Rail Excursion (KTX / Line 1) → Suwon King Galbi Lunch

schedule.title: Rail Excursion: Seoul Station to Suwon Station
schedule.detail: Board direct KTX (30 mins) or rapid commuter train down the historic Gyeongbu line to Suwon.

schedule.title: Suwon Hwaseong Fortress (UNESCO World Heritage)
schedule.detail: Walk the 5.7km stone fortress battlements, secret gates (Ammun), and watchtowers built in 1796 by King Jeongjo, trying traditional Korean archery (Gukgung) at Yeonmudae.
schedule.logistics: Suwon Station + Bus 11/13 to Paldalmun or Hwaseomun.

schedule.title: Famous Suwon Wang Galbi (King's Beef Ribs) Feast
schedule.detail: Feast on Suwon's legendary massive marinated beef short ribs grilled over charcoal.

schedule.title: Hwaseong Haenggung Temporary Palace
schedule.detail: Tour the royal detached palace where King Jeongjo stayed during ancestral visits.

schedule.title: Return Rail to Seoul Station
schedule.detail: Smooth 30-minute train ride back to central Seoul.

schedule.title: Seoul Station Rest & Dinner
schedule.detail: Relax and dine near Seoul Station base.

blocks.label: Rail Mastery Excursion
blocks.text: Demonstrates the power of Korea's rail network to explore a premier UNESCO World Heritage fortress just 30 minutes from Seoul.

blocks.label: Epicurean Suwon Beef
blocks.text: Suwon Wang Galbi is internationally renowned for its colossal size and sweet fruit-and-garlic marinade.

days.food: Lunch: Suwon Wang Galbi (King beef short ribs grilled over charcoal). Dinner: Seoul Station warm bibimbap or noodle soup.
days.reservationNote: Suwon Hwaseong fortress open year-round; archery experience ₩2,000.
days.costNote: Train round-trip ~₩16,000; Suwon Wang Galbi lunch ~₩45,000 per person.
days.watchouts: Wear walking shoes for walking fortress stone slopes.
days.planB: Hwaseong Haenggung exhibition halls and Suwon Museum provide indoor shelter.

days.title: Creative Greenways, Street Buskers & Charcoal Galbi
days.anchor: Hongdae Shopping & Indie Culture → Gyeongui Line Forest Park → Mapo Charcoal BBQ

schedule.title: Gyeongui Line Forest Park Stroll
schedule.detail: Walk the transformed former railway corridor lined with boutique shops, craft bakeries, and autumn trees.
schedule.logistics: Hongik Univ. Station Line 2 / AREX Exit 3.

schedule.title: Yeonnam-dong Trendy Dining Lunch
schedule.detail: Enjoy artisanal handmade pasta, Korean rice bowls, or fresh bakery treats in trendy Yeonnam-dong.

schedule.title: Hongdae Shopping & Indie Arts Street
schedule.detail: Browse unique Korean streetwear, stationary shops (Object, KT&G Sangsangmadang), and photo studios.

schedule.title: Hongdae Live Street Busking
schedule.detail: Watch talented young K-pop dancers, acoustic musicians, and indie performers on Hongdae busking street.

schedule.title: Mapo Charcoal Galbi Barbecue Feast
schedule.detail: Feast on marinated pork ribs grilled over charcoal accompanied by refreshing cold dongchimi broth.

blocks.label: Youth Energy
blocks.text: Hongdae comes alive in the afternoon and evening with creative youth culture and music.

blocks.label: Walkable Greenway
blocks.text: Forest park provides a calming pedestrian buffer between bustling commercial streets.

days.food: Lunch: Yeonnam-dong Korean fusion bibimbap or burger. Dinner: Mapo Original Galbi pork ribs.
days.reservationNote: Most retail and indie shops in Hongdae open around 11:00 AM.
days.costNote: Budget ~₩40,000 per person for dining and dessert cafes.
days.watchouts: Evening crowds in Hongdae get dense; keep valuables secure.
days.planB: KT&G Sangsangmadang offers multi-floor indoor art gallery, cinema, and design shop.

days.title: Towering Libraries, Ancient Temples & Rail Preparation
days.anchor: Starfield COEX Library → Bongeunsa Millennium Temple → Sunday KTX to Cheonan Prep

schedule.title: Starfield COEX Library & Mega Mall
schedule.detail: Photograph the magnificent 13-meter tall book towers at Starfield Library and browse Asia's largest underground shopping complex.
schedule.logistics: Samseong Station Line 2 Exit 6 or Bongeunsa Station Line 9 Exit 7.

schedule.title: Parnas Mall Gourmet Lunch
schedule.detail: Enjoy Korean modern beef soup (gomtang) or royal hot pot in the lower level gourmet arcade.

schedule.title: Bongeunsa Buddhist Temple
schedule.detail: Step across the street into an ancient peaceful temple founded in 794 AD, home to a majestic 23-meter stone Maitreya Buddha.

schedule.title: Seoul Station Packing & Train Check
schedule.detail: Return to Seoul Station base, pack luggage for Sunday morning KTX to Cheonan-Asan, and verify seat reservations.

schedule.title: Seoul Station Farewell Korean Stew Dinner
schedule.detail: Enjoy boiling army base stew (budae jjigae) or bibimbap.

blocks.label: Temple & Modernity
blocks.text: Bongeunsa's ancient wood stands in stunning contrast to Gangnam's glass skyscrapers.

blocks.label: Lightning Rail Leap Prep
blocks.text: Packing early ensures a relaxed Sunday morning 35-minute KTX train to Cheonan.

days.food: Lunch: Hadongkwan 80-year Gomtang beef soup at COEX. Dinner: Seoul Station hearty budae jjigae hot pot.
days.reservationNote: Bongeunsa Temple is free entry; open until 22:00.
days.costNote: Free entry to COEX library and temple; Dinner ~₩20,000 per person.
days.watchouts: COEX underground mall is vast; follow overhead color-coded floor lines.
days.planB: COEX mall is 100% weather-proof and indoor.

days.title: Lightning High-Speed Rail Leap & World-Class Sculpture Plaza
days.anchor: Morning KTX Seoul to Cheonan-Asan (35 mins) → Arario Sculpture Park (Damien Hirst, Keith Haring) → 1934 Hakhwa Hodu-gwaja

schedule.title: KTX High-Speed Rail Seoul to Cheonan-Asan
schedule.detail: Ultra-fast 35-minute high-speed journey from Seoul Station to Cheonan-Asan Station.
schedule.logistics: Board train at Seoul Station; arrives before you finish a coffee!

schedule.title: Hotel Check-in & Base Setup
schedule.detail: Check into hotel (e.g. Shilla Stay Cheonan or Ramada Encore Cheonan-Asan) and drop bags.

schedule.title: Shinbu-dong Gourmet Lunch
schedule.detail: Enjoy Korean hand-cut noodles or stone-pot rice in central Cheonan.

schedule.title: Arario Sculpture Park Cheonan
schedule.detail: Walk the world-famous open-air sculpture park featuring colossal original masterpieces: Damien Hirst's 6-meter 'Hymn' and 'Charity', Keith Haring's vibrant bronzes, and Arman's tower of 99 car axles.

schedule.title: 1934 Original Hakhwa Hodu-gwaja Bakery
schedule.detail: Visit Korea's most historic walnut pastry bakery (founded 1934 by Grandmother Sim Bok-sun) to taste freshly baked, steaming hot walnut cakes filled with whole walnut chunks and smooth white/red bean paste.

schedule.title: Cheonan Sizzling Bulgogi & Suyuk Dinner
schedule.detail: Feast on tender seasoned beef bulgogi with fresh side dishes.

blocks.label: Lightning Rail Leap
blocks.text: At just 35 minutes on the KTX, Cheonan is the most rail-efficient transit stop in South Korea.

blocks.label: World Art Landmark
blocks.text: Arario Sculpture Park is one of the few places in Asia exhibiting monumental works by Damien Hirst and Keith Haring in a public urban plaza.

days.food: Lunch: Shinsegae Cheonan gourmet dining. Afternoon: 1934 Hakhwa freshly baked warm Hodu-gwaja walnut pastries. Dinner: Cheonan charcoal-grilled Hanwoo beef bulgogi.
days.reservationNote: Book KTX Seoul→Cheonan-Asan on Korail app 30 days in advance.
days.costNote: KTX ticket ~₩14,100; Arario sculpture park is free open-air plaza; Hodu-gwaja box ~₩6,000.
days.watchouts: Eat Hakhwa Hodu-gwaja while warm from the bakery oven for peak crispness.
days.planB: Arario Gallery Cheonan and Shinsegae Department Store provide full indoor comfort.

days.title: Vast Monumental Exhibits & Korea's Longest Autumn Maple Tunnel
days.anchor: Independence Hall of Korea (Grand Complex & Maple Tree Tunnel) → Autumn Foliage Walk

schedule.title: Independence Hall of Korea (Exhibition Halls 1–6)
schedule.detail: Tour Korea's foremost patriotic national monument: the colossal Grand Hall of the Nation (roof tiled with 40,000 copper tiles), the Monument to the Nation, and expansive multimedia exhibits documenting Korean resistance against colonial rule.
schedule.logistics: Dongnam-gu Mokcheon-eup; City Bus 381/382/383 from Cheonan Station or 20-min taxi.

schedule.title: Mokcheon Traditional Country Lunch
schedule.detail: Enjoy hearty country soybean paste stew (doenjang jjigae), acorn jelly, and grilled fish.

schedule.title: Independence Hall Autumn Maple Tree Tunnel Walk
schedule.detail: Walk the spectacular 3.2km paved pedestrian path shaded by thousands of crimson and golden maple trees encircling the complex.

schedule.title: Return to Cheonan & Rest
schedule.detail: Relax at hotel or explore local cafes in Shinbu-dong.

schedule.title: Cheonan Charcoal Pork BBQ Dinner
schedule.detail: Feast on thick pork neck and steaming kimchi stew.

blocks.label: National Heritage Monument
blocks.text: Independence Hall is the emotional and historical epicenter of modern Korean national identity.

blocks.label: Peak Maple Tunnel
blocks.text: The 3.2km Maple Tree Tunnel is widely celebrated as one of Korea's most magnificent autumn foliage walks in mid-November.

days.food: Lunch: Mokcheon traditional soybean stew and grilled mackerel. Dinner: Shinbu-dong charcoal-grilled pork barbecue with soybean paste stew.
days.reservationNote: Independence Hall of Korea is free admission; closed on Mondays (outdoor park grounds remain open).
days.costNote: Independence Hall is free; Taxi ~₩15,000 each way; Dinner ~₩25,000 per person.
days.watchouts: The complex is vast (over 1 million pyeong); wear comfortable walking shoes.
days.planB: All 7 massive exhibition halls are fully indoor and climate-controlled.

days.title: National Heroes & 50-Year Heritage Blood Sausage Alley
days.anchor: Yu Gwan-sun Memorial Hall & Aunae Market → Byeongcheon Soondae Street Feast

schedule.title: Yu Gwan-sun Memorial Hall & Historic Shrine
schedule.detail: Honor 16-year-old independence hero Yu Gwan-sun at her memorial hall, birthplace, and beacon fire site on Maebongsan Mountain, where the March 1st 1919 independence demonstration was ignited.
schedule.logistics: Dongnam-gu Byeongcheon-myeon; City Bus 400/402 or 25-min taxi.

schedule.title: Byeongcheon Soondae Alley (Korea's Famous Blood Sausage Capital)
schedule.detail: Feast on authentic Byeongcheon Soondae Gukbap: tender small intestine stuffed with cellophane noodles, fresh vegetables, and pork blood simmered in rich bone broth, served with steaming sliced soondae and pork cuts.

schedule.title: Aunae Traditional Marketplace Walk
schedule.detail: Stroll the historic marketplace where thousands gathered in 1919 waving national flags, sampling traditional candy and rice crisps.

schedule.title: Cheonan Samgeori Park Heritage Walk
schedule.detail: Walk the scenic willow-lined lake and classical pavilions where Korea's historic Gyeongbu and Honam royal highways intersected.

schedule.title: Cheonan Hanwoo Beef Feast
schedule.detail: Savor grilled Korean Hanwoo beef tenderloin.

blocks.label: Sacred Patriotism
blocks.text: Yu Gwan-sun is often called the Joan of Arc of Korea, inspiring generations with her fearless courage.

blocks.label: Culinary Heritage Alley
blocks.text: Byeongcheon Soondae is nationally distinct for its heavy vegetable content and delicate, non-greasy flavor.

days.food: Lunch: Famous Byeongcheon Soondae Gukbap (authentic pork blood sausage soup with assorted meats). Dinner: Cheonan charcoal-grilled Hanwoo beef with doenjang stew.
days.reservationNote: Yu Gwan-sun Memorial Hall is free admission; open daily.
days.costNote: Memorial Hall free; Soondae lunch ~₩10,000; Dinner ~₩35,000 per person.
days.watchouts: Soondae soup is seasoned to taste with salted shrimp (saeujeot) and red pepper paste (dadeagi).
days.planB: Yu Gwan-sun Memorial Hall and Byeongcheon restaurants are fully indoor.

days.title: Monumental Bronze Statues & Pine Mountain Forests
days.anchor: Gakwonsa Temple (Colossal 15-Meter Bronze Buddha) → Taejosan Mountain Trail

schedule.title: Gakwonsa Temple & Grand Bronze Buddha
schedule.detail: Climb the 203 stone stairs to behold the colossal 15-meter-tall, 60-ton seated Bronze Amita Buddha overlooking Taejosan Mountain, exploring the massive wooden main prayer hall (Daeungbojeon).
schedule.logistics: Dongnam-gu Anseo-dong; City Bus 24 or 15-min taxi from station.

schedule.title: Anseo-dong Mountain Village Lunch
schedule.detail: Enjoy buckwheat cold noodles (makguksu), potato pancakes, and wild mountain herb bibimbap near the temple lake.

schedule.title: Taejosan Mountain Pine Forest Walk
schedule.detail: Walk the shaded pine paths and visit the Taejosan Park sculpture garden and mountain reservoir.

schedule.title: Shinbu-dong Shopping & Coffee
schedule.detail: Relax at a specialty cafe in central Cheonan.

schedule.title: Cheonan Charcoal Pork Galbi BBQ Dinner
schedule.detail: Enjoy sweet soy-marinated pork ribs grilled over hardwood charcoal.

blocks.label: Colossal Buddhist Monument
blocks.text: Gakwonsa's Bronze Buddha is one of the largest outdoor bronze statues in Asia, second only to the Buddha at Todaiji in Japan.

blocks.label: Autumn Mountain Vista
blocks.text: Taejosan provides tranquil pine forest trails and panoramic views across the Cheonan valley.

days.food: Lunch: Anseo-dong buckwheat makguksu and potato pancake. Dinner: Charcoal-grilled pork galbi with cold noodles.
days.reservationNote: Gakwonsa Temple is free admission; open year-round from dawn to dusk.
days.costNote: Temple free; Makguksu lunch ~₩12,000; Dinner ~₩25,000 per person.
days.watchouts: Climbing the 203 stairs to the Buddha statue is paved; ramp access also available.
days.planB: Daeungbojeon hall and temple tea rooms provide indoor shelter.

days.title: Wooden Lake Boardwalks, Market Snacks & Rail Preparation
days.anchor: Seongseong Lake Park Boardwalk Sunset → Cheonan Namsan Central Market → KTX to Busan Prep

schedule.title: Seongseong Lake Park & Eco-Boardwalk
schedule.detail: Walk the scenic wooden boardwalk loop around Seongseong Lake, visiting the bird observatory, reed fields, and modern waterfront cafes.
schedule.logistics: Seobuk-gu Seongseong-dong; City Bus 5 or 15-min taxi.

schedule.title: Seongseong Lakefront Cafe & Lunch
schedule.detail: Enjoy artisanal brunch, pasta, or Korean rice sets overlooking the water.

schedule.title: Cheonan Namsan Central Market Crawl
schedule.detail: Browse Cheonan's largest traditional covered market, tasting handmade dumplings, knife-cut noodles, hotteok, and picking up regional walnut snacks.

schedule.title: Hotel Packing & KTX Ticket Verification
schedule.detail: Pack luggage for Friday morning KTX to coastal Busan and confirm seat assignments.

schedule.title: Cheonan Farewell Korean Feast
schedule.detail: Celebrate 5 nights in Cheonan with rich mushroom beef hot pot (shabu-shabu).

blocks.label: Lakeside Tranquility
blocks.text: Seongseong Lake Park provides a modern, serene boardwalk promenade to cap your Cheonan stay.

blocks.label: Pre-Coastal Preparation
blocks.text: Packing early guarantees a stress-free Friday morning KTX train directly to Busan.

days.food: Lunch: Seongseong lakefront cafe brunch. Afternoon: Namsan Market handmade dumplings & hotteok. Dinner: Cheonan beef and mushroom hot pot shabu-shabu.
days.reservationNote: Seongseong Lake Park is open 24/7; admission is free.
days.costNote: Park free; Market snacks ~₩8,000; Dinner ~₩25,000 per person.
days.watchouts: Pack primary bags tonight for Friday morning KTX to Busan.
days.planB: Namsan Central Market is a fully covered weather-proof arcade.

days.title: Coastward Bound: Direct High-Speed Rail to the Southern Sea
days.anchor: KTX Cheonan-Asan to Busan (1h45m) → Haeundae Check-in → Sunset Beach Walk

schedule.title: KTX High-Speed Rail to Busan
schedule.detail: Smooth 1-hour 45-minute direct high-speed journey from Cheonan-Asan Station to Busan Station on the southern sea.

schedule.title: Busan Station Choryang Milmyeon Lunch
schedule.detail: Savor authentic cold wheat noodles and steamed king dumplings.

schedule.title: Transfer to Haeundae Beachfront Base
schedule.detail: Check into Haeundae hotel (e.g. L7 Haeundae or Felix by STX).
schedule.logistics: Metro Line 2 or taxi across harbor bridge.

schedule.title: Haeundae Beach Promenade & Dongbaek Island Walk
schedule.detail: Stroll white sands of Haeundae Beach and follow the wooden coastal boardwalk around pine-forested Dongbaek Island to APEC Nurimaru House.

schedule.title: Haeundae Traditional Market Seafood Dinner
schedule.detail: Walk Haeundae market street and feast on fresh grilled seafood hot pot, sea eel, and seed hotteok (ssiat hotteok).

blocks.label: Direct Rail Efficiency
blocks.text: Direct KTX from Cheonan-Asan arrives in Busan before noon, leaving the full afternoon for coastal exploration.

blocks.label: Haeundae Anchor
blocks.text: Staying in Haeundae provides seven nights of oceanfront serenity without hotel moves.

days.food: Lunch: Choryang Milmyeon (cold wheat noodles & giant dumplings). Dinner: Haeundae Market grilled seafood hot pot & ssiat hotteok.
days.reservationNote: Book KTX Cheonan-Asan→Busan on Korail app 30 days in advance.
days.costNote: KTX ticket ~₩46,500 per person.
days.watchouts: Dongbaek Island trail is paved and lighted; Nurimaru APEC House closes at 17:00.
days.planB: SEA LIFE Busan Aquarium on Haeundae beachfront provides indoor shelter.

days.title: Scenic Coastal Railway, Seaside Cliff Sanctuaries & Saturday Lights
days.anchor: Haeundae Blueline Sky Capsule to Cheongsapo → Haedong Yonggungsa Temple → Saturday Drones

schedule.title: Haeundae Blueline Park Sky Capsule (Mipo to Cheongsapo)
schedule.detail: Ride a private colorful Sky Capsule cabin suspended 10 meters above the sea along coastal cliff tracks.
schedule.logistics: Mipo Station; book tickets 2 weeks in advance.

schedule.title: Cheongsapo Twin Lighthouses & Grilled Clam Lunch
schedule.detail: Photograph red and white lighthouses, walk Daritdol Skywalk, and enjoy fresh grilled clams with butter and cheese.

schedule.title: Haedong Yonggungsa Temple (Temple by the Sea)
schedule.detail: Visit Korea's dramatic Buddhist temple built directly onto coastal granite rocks above crashing waves.

schedule.title: Ananti Cove & Coastal Walk
schedule.detail: Explore luxury ocean promenade and seaside cafes in Gijang.

schedule.title: Gwangalli Beach & Saturday Drone Light Show
schedule.detail: Watch 500+ synchronized LED drones dance above Gwangan Bridge from the sand.

blocks.label: Eastern Coastal Synergy
blocks.text: Blueline Park, Cheongsapo, Yonggungsa, and Gwangalli form a natural eastern coastline day.

blocks.label: Saturday Drone Spectacular
blocks.text: Timed specifically for Saturday evening to witness Gwangalli's world-renowned drone performance.

days.food: Lunch: Cheongsapo seaside grilled clams (jogae-gui) with butter and cheese. Dinner: Gwangalli beachfront raw yellowtail sashimi or Korean craft beer and fried chicken.
days.reservationNote: Book Blueline Sky Capsule 14 days in advance on official website.
days.costNote: Sky Capsule 2-person cabin ₩35,000; Yonggungsa Temple is free entry.
days.watchouts: Haedong Yonggungsa has stone steps down to the cliffs; wear non-slip shoes.
days.planB: Eternal Journey Bookstore at Ananti and Centum City provide indoor alternatives.

days.title: Pastel Terraced Alleys & Korea's Largest Marine Market
days.anchor: Gamcheon Culture Village → Jagalchi Fish Market → BIFF Square

schedule.title: Gamcheon Culture Village Walk
schedule.detail: Wander terraced hillside alleys painted in pastel hues and photograph the famous Little Prince statue overlooking the harbor.
schedule.logistics: Toseong Station Line 1 Exit 6 + local bus Saha 1-1.

schedule.title: Jagalchi Fish Market Feast
schedule.detail: Explore Korea's biggest seafood market, dining on fresh seasonal sashimi and spicy fish stew in the second-floor market hall.

schedule.title: BIFF Square & Bupyeong Kkangtong Market
schedule.detail: Walk the film festival handprint square, taste famous seed hotteok, and browse traditional retro market alleys.

schedule.title: Yongdusan Park & Busan Tower Night View
schedule.detail: Ride outdoor escalator up to Yongdusan Park to view twinkling harbor lights.

schedule.title: Nampo-dong Dwaeji Gukbap Dinner
schedule.detail: Enjoy boiling pork bone soup with tender pork slices and chives.

blocks.label: Old Busan Heritage
blocks.text: Reveals the resilient history of wartime refugees in Gamcheon and the maritime spirit of Jagalchi.

blocks.label: Market Immersion
blocks.text: Jagalchi and BIFF street snacks showcase essential Busan culinary culture.

days.food: Lunch: Jagalchi Market fresh flounder sashimi & spicy fish soup. Dinner: Traditional Busan Dwaeji Gukbap (pork bone soup).
days.reservationNote: Gamcheon village maps available at tourist center for ₩2,000.
days.costNote: Gamcheon entry free; Busan Tower observation deck ₩12,000.
days.watchouts: Gamcheon is a living residential village; keep noise low.
days.planB: Jagalchi 7-story indoor market building provides complete shelter.

days.title: Free Hillside Stair Elevator & 1,300-Year Silla Sanctuaries
days.anchor: Choryang 168 Stairs & Haneul-gil Elevator & Sanbokdoro Scenic Road → Beomeosa Mountain Temple

itineraries.title: Smart Value & Authentic Neighborhood Living (Value & Local Living)
itineraries.bestFor: Budget-conscious travelers, backpackers, solo explorers, and savvy planners who love authentic traditional markets, free panoramic city wall trails, neighborhood food alleys, and maximum transit value.
itineraries.decisionSummary: A brilliantly cost-effective 21-night itinerary leveraging Korea's incredible free public treasures (Seoul City Wall, National Palace Museum, Independence Hall, Choryang 168 Stairs hillside elevator, Dadaepo reed trails) alongside authentic market feasts and budget-smart Cheonan hotel pricing.
itineraries.recommendation: Choose this route if you want to stretch your travel budget further while experiencing genuine Korean everyday neighborhood life, street snacks, and panoramic public parks.
itineraries.tradeoff: More meals taken at traditional market stalls and casual neighborhood eateries rather than luxury hotel dining rooms.

Secure timed reservations for special experiences (e.g. Changdeokgung Secret Garden, Blueline Sky Capsule, Spa Land).

itineraries.shortTitle: Seoul · Cheonan · Busan (Gentle Leisure & Family Comfort)
itineraries.title: Family Comfort, Gentle Parks & Relaxed Leisure (Gentle Leisure & Family Comfort)
itineraries.bestFor: Families with children, senior travelers, multi-generational groups, and travelers who prefer relaxed 10:00 AM starts, unhurried pacing, flat accessible walking paths, world-class aquariums, and heated mineral water parks.
itineraries.decisionSummary: A thoughtfully paced, low-stress 21-night itinerary designed around 10:00 AM daily starts, barrier-free attractions, and spacious leisure destinations: Lotte World Tower & Aquarium, Children's Grand Park, Sono Belle indoor thermal water park, Hong Dae-yong science planetarium, Haeundae Sky Capsules, and Centum Cinema Center.
itineraries.recommendation: Choose this route if you want to experience Korea's beauty without early morning alarms, frantic schedules, or strenuous mountain climbing.
itineraries.tradeoff: Gentler pacing means fewer total attractions visited per day in exchange for deep comfort and rest.

bases.why: Immediate access to Seoul Station for the short 35-minute KTX hop to Cheonan-Asan, direct AREX connection, and walking proximity to Deoksugung, Namdaemun, and Jongno.
hotelIdeas: Four Points by Sheraton Josun Seoul Station
Nine Tree Premier Hotel Myeongdong II

itineraries.title: World Sculpture Parks, Urban Design & Creative Hubs (Contemporary Art & Architecture)
itineraries.bestFor: Architects, designers, contemporary art curators, sculptors, and creative travelers captivated by Pritzker Prize architecture, monumental public sculpture plazas (Damien Hirst, Keith Haring), adaptive reuse lofts, and cutting-edge digital media art.
itineraries.decisionSummary: A visionary aesthetic journey spanning Kim Swoo-geun's brutalist SPACE building, Zaha Hadid's DDP, and the Leeum Pritzker trio in Seoul, Cheonan's world-renowned Arario Sculpture Park (Damien Hirst, Keith Haring), and Busan's Patrick Blanc vertical garden at MoCA, P.ARK shipyard amphitheater, and F1963 wire factory arts space.
itineraries.recommendation: Choose this route if your travel passion is world-class contemporary art, innovative urban architecture, and post-industrial creative transformations.
itineraries.tradeoff: More time dedicated to galleries, architectural masterworks, and sculpture parks than traditional outdoor sports.

itineraries.title: Artisan Gastronomy, Regional Craft & Market Feasts (Regional Gastronomy & Artisans)
itineraries.bestFor: Connoisseurs of Korean culinary heritage, Michelin gourmands, lovers of centuries-old lineages (Hakhwa Hodu-gwaja, Byeongcheon Soondae, Dongnae Pajeon), and travelers seeking authentic regional craft wines and temple banquets.
itineraries.decisionSummary: An epicurean odyssey linking Michelin-starred Buddhist temple cuisine and Majang 1++ Hanwoo beef in Seoul, 90-year-old Hakhwa walnut bakeries, Byeongcheon soondae alley, and Seonghwan pear wine in Cheonan, culminating in Busan's royal scallion pancakes, Gijang snow crabs, and emerald abalone cauldrons.
itineraries.recommendation: Choose this route if you want to explore the finest regional culinary lineages and artisan food traditions across South Korea.
itineraries.tradeoff: Requires reserving special Michelin temple dining in advance and traveling to regional culinary alleys for authentic dining.

bookingPriorities: Reconcile SFO outbound flight with Nov 1 21:00 local ICN arrival and Nov 22 13:00 departure.
Reserve 4 hotel base stays with free cancellation (Seoul 7N, Cheonan 5N, Busan 7N, Seoul 2N).
Book 3 KTX rail legs on Korail app 30 days prior (Seoul→Cheonan-Asan, Cheonan-Asan→Busan, Busan→Seoul).
Reserve AREX Non-Stop Airport Express tickets and pre-order Korea eSIM / T-Money / WOWPASS card.
Secure timed reservations for special experiences (e.g. Changdeokgung Secret Garden, Blueline Sky Capsule, Spa Land).

days.title: Epicurean Landing & Calming Welcome Reset
days.anchor: ICN arrival at 21:00 → late transfer → gentle craft tea & light snack → restorative sleep

schedule.title: ICN Arrival & Border Clearance
schedule.detail: Clear immigration smoothly, collect checked luggage, and pick up pre-arranged transportation cards.

schedule.title: Direct Transfer to Central Seoul Base
schedule.detail: Airport Limousine Bus or official taxi directly to Myeongdong / Seoul Station hotel.

schedule.title: Craft Barley Tea & Rest
schedule.detail: Hydrate with warm roasted grain tea, unpack essentials, and rest deeply before the culinary journey begins.

blocks.label: Palate Preparation
blocks.text: Starting gently with roasted herbal tea protects the digestive system after international flights.

blocks.label: Station Proximity
blocks.text: Seoul Station base provides immediate access to historic dining alleys and high-speed rail.

days.food: Light roasted barley tea and warm rice snack.
days.reservationNote: Confirm late check-in with hotel in writing.
days.costNote: Limousine Bus ~₩17,000.
days.watchouts: Save full appetite for tomorrow's Michelin temple cuisine banquet.
days.planB: Hotel front desk provides 24-hour service.

days.title: Michelin Buddhist Temple Dining & Centuries-Old Tea Lineages
days.anchor: Balwoo Gongyang (Michelin Temple Cuisine) → Insadong Traditional Teahouses & Fermented Confectionery

schedule.title: Jogyesa Zen Buddhist Temple Stroll
schedule.detail: Walk among centuries-old locust trees and golden autumn chrysanthemum flower displays at the headquarters of Korean Zen Buddhism.
schedule.logistics: Anguk Station Line 3 Exit 6 or Jonggak Station Line 1 Exit 2.

schedule.title: Balwoo Gongyang (Michelin-Starred Temple Cuisine)
schedule.detail: Experience Korea's definitive temple cuisine banquet, crafted without garlic, onions, or artificial seasonings, using 10-year aged soy sauces, fermented mountain mushrooms, and lotus root.
schedule.logistics: Directly opposite Jogyesa Temple (Temple Stay Information Center 5F).

schedule.title: Insadong Artisanal Teahouse & Confectionery
schedule.detail: Sip deep roasted Ssanggwa-cha (medicinal herbal tea with egg yolk) or sweet Omija tea paired with handmade yakgwa (honey pastry) in a 100-year-old wooden hanok teahouse.

schedule.title: Bukchon Hanok Promenade
schedule.detail: Stroll traditional stone alleys under autumn twilight.

schedule.title: Myeongdong Kyoja Michelin Bib Gourmand Dinner
schedule.detail: Savor handmade kalguksu noodles in rich chicken broth and steamed pork mandu dumplings with pungent garlic kimchi.

blocks.label: Philosophical Gastronomy
blocks.text: Balwoo Gongyang illustrates how Korean temple food elevates mindfulness and natural fermentation into haute cuisine.

blocks.label: Artisan Tea Heritage
blocks.text: Insadong preserves Korea's ancient tea ceremony aesthetics and medicinal herbal decoctions.

days.food: Lunch: Balwoo Gongyang Michelin Temple Course (fermented seasonal roots and temple broths). Afternoon: Traditional omija tea & yakgwa. Dinner: Myeongdong Kyoja kalguksu and steamed mandu.
days.reservationNote: Reserve Balwoo Gongyang 30 days in advance online (essential for lunch tasting menu).
days.costNote: Balwoo Gongyang course ~₩45,000–₩65,000; Dinner ~₩11,000 per person.
days.watchouts: Temple cuisine avoids the 5 pungent alliums (garlic, onion, chives, leeks, scallions) to promote clarity.
days.planB: Balwoo Gongyang and Insadong hanok teahouses are fully indoor.

days.title: Korea's Crown Jewel Beef & Master Specialty Roasters
days.anchor: Majang Meat Wholesale Market 1++ Hanwoo Beef Tasting → Seongsu Artisan Coffee Roasteries

schedule.title: Majang Meat Wholesale Market & Hanwoo Barbecue
schedule.detail: Select prime 1++ Korean Hanwoo beef ribeye, sirloin, and tenderloin directly from master butchers, grilling it over charcoal at a 2nd-floor specialty dining hall.
schedule.logistics: Majang Station Line 5 Exit 2 or Yongdu Station Line 2.

schedule.title: Seongsu Specialty Coffee Roasters (Center Coffee, Daelim Warehouse)
schedule.detail: Sample single-origin pour-over brews, Geisha varietals, and artisan butter salt bread in converted industrial loft bakeries.

schedule.title: Seoul Forest Autumn Ginkgo Canopy Stroll
schedule.detail: Walk under golden ginkgo trees to refresh between rich feasts.

schedule.title: Seongsu Modern Craft Makgeolli Pub
schedule.detail: Pair artisanal cloudy rice wine with crispy truffle potato pancakes and braised pork belly.

blocks.label: Peak Marbling Quality
blocks.text: 1++ Hanwoo is Korea's indigenous beef marbling pinnacle, delivering intense umami and melt-in-mouth tenderness.

blocks.label: Specialty Coffee Capital
blocks.text: Seongsu is East Asia's premier laboratory for third-wave specialty coffee roasting.

days.food: Lunch: Majang Market 1++ Hanwoo beef charcoal grill with doenjang jjigae. Afternoon: Seongsu artisanal pour-over coffee & canelé. Dinner: Seongsu craft makgeolli & crispy gamjajeon potato pancake.
days.reservationNote: Purchase meat cuts on 1F butcher stalls; pay table setting fee (₩6,000) at 2F grill room.
days.costNote: Hanwoo lunch ~₩60,000–₩85,000 per person; exceptional direct wholesale value.
days.watchouts: Pair rich Hanwoo beef with fresh wasabi, ssam leafy greens, and sea salt.
days.planB: Majang indoor grill halls and Seongsu cafes are warm and sheltered.

days.title: 70-Year Cold Noodle Lineages & Midnight Market Griddles
days.anchor: Jongno Wooraeok (Historic 1946 Pyongyang Naengmyeon) → Gwangjang Traditional Food Market

schedule.title: Wooraeok (Since 1946 Heritage Pyongyang Naengmyeon)
schedule.detail: Savor Korea's definitive cold buckwheat noodles in 100% pure chilled Hanwoo beef broth, paired with traditional charcoal-grilled bulgogi.
schedule.logistics: Euljiro 4-ga Station Line 2/5 Exit 4 (arrive by 11:00 AM).

schedule.title: Cheonggyecheon Stream & Insadong Craft Alleys
schedule.detail: Walk the sunken urban stream to explore artisan ceramics and tea ware in Insadong.

schedule.title: Ikseon-dong Hanok Dessert Crawl
schedule.detail: Sample steamed egg toast, soufflé pancakes, and black sesame gelato in restored hanok courtyards.

schedule.title: Gwangjang Traditional Market Grand Feast
schedule.detail: Feast on crispy bindaetteok (mung bean pancake fried in oil), mayak gimbap with mustard dip, fresh yukhoe (beef tartare with pear and raw egg yolk), and draft makgeolli.

blocks.label: 70-Year Cold Noodle Benchmark
blocks.text: Wooraeok is universally regarded as the gold standard of authentic North Korean Pyongyang-style beef cold noodles.

blocks.label: Living Market Culture
blocks.text: Gwangjang Market offers the most vibrant street food theater in South Korea.

days.food: Lunch: Wooraeok Pyongyang naengmyeon & Hanwoo beef bulgogi. Afternoon: Hanok cafe dessert. Dinner: Gwangjang Market bindaetteok, mayak gimbap, yukhoe, and draft makgeolli.
days.reservationNote: Wooraeok does not accept reservations; register on tablet waitlist at 11:00 AM.
days.costNote: Wooraeok lunch ~₩30,000; Gwangjang market dinner ~₩20,000 per person.
days.watchouts: Pyongyang naengmyeon broth has a subtle, clean beef flavor; taste broth before adding vinegar or mustard.
days.planB: Wooraeok and Gwangjang covered market roof provide complete weather protection.

days.title: Hardwood Charcoal Ribs & Assorted Savory Pancakes

schedule.title: Mangwon Traditional Neighborhood Market
schedule.detail: Sample sweet & spicy boneless fried chicken (dakgangjeong), handmade croquettes, and hotteok.

schedule.title: Gongdeok Jeon (Pancake) & Jokbal Alley
schedule.detail: Fill wicker trays with assorted savory pancakes (jeon, stuffed peppers, shrimp, fish, meat patties) fried fresh on massive flat-top griddles.

schedule.title: Gyeongui Line Forest Park Digestive Stroll
schedule.detail: Walk the transformed leafy railway corridor.

schedule.title: Mapo Charcoal Pork Galbi Feast
schedule.detail: Feast on succulent pork ribs marinated in sweet soy and garlic, grilled over glowing hardwood charcoal with steaming egg custard and cold dongchimi broth.

blocks.label: Self-Curated Jeon Trays
blocks.text: Gongdeok Jeon alley allows guests to pick custom combinations of savory traditional pancakes.

days.title: Live Giant King Crabs, Yellowtail Sashimi & Fish Stew Cauldrons
days.anchor: Noryangjin Fish Wholesale Market (Live King Crab & Sashimi) → Han River Sunset Stroll

schedule.title: Noryangjin Wholesale Fisheries Market Feast
schedule.detail: Select live King Crab, Snow Crab, or fresh seasonal yellowtail (bangeo) sashimi from 1F stalls and have it steamed and prepared immediately on 2F with crab-roe fried rice and spicy fish stew (maeuntang).
schedule.logistics: Noryangjin Station Line 1/9 direct footbridge connection.

schedule.title: Yeouido The Hyundai Gourmet Supermarket
schedule.detail: Browse the sprawling Tasty Seoul basement food hall, discovering boutique confectioneries, matcha lattes, and artisan snacks.
schedule.logistics: Yeouido Station Line 5/9 direct underground walkway.

schedule.title: Yeouido Hangang Park Sunset Walk
schedule.detail: Relax along the Han River waterfront as twilight illuminates the bridges.

schedule.title: Sindang-dong Tteokbokki Town Feasting
schedule.detail: Experience the historic 1953 birthplace of tabletop tteokbokki, boiling rice cakes, fish cakes, ramen, and fried dumplings in sweet chili black-bean broth.

blocks.label: Wholesale Marine Freshness
blocks.text: Noryangjin connects ocean catch directly to your table within minutes of selection.

blocks.label: Street Comfort Contrast
blocks.text: Transitions from luxury marine seafood to nostalgic comfort food in Sindang-dong.

days.title: Slow-Simmered Beef Broths, Hand-Torn Noodles & Rail Preparation

schedule.title: Hadongkwan Traditional Beef Gomtang (Since 1939)
schedule.detail: Taste Seoul's definitive slow-simmered beef brisket soup, served with tender tripe, spring onions, and aged radish kkakdugi.

schedule.title: Samcheong-dong Sujebi & Bukchon Walk

blocks.label: Heritage Simmered Broths
blocks.text: Hadongkwan and Samcheongdong Sujebi showcase Korea's mastery of comforting bone and anchovy broths.

blocks.label: Rail Preparation
blocks.text: Packing early ensures an effortless Sunday morning 35-minute rail leap to Cheonan.

days.food: Breakfast/Brunch: Hadongkwan traditional Hanwoo gomtang soup. Lunch: Samcheong-dong handmade sujebi and gamjajeon. Dinner: Chuncheon spicy dakgalbi with mozzarella cheese and bokkeumbap.

schedule.title: Hotel Check-in & Base Setup

schedule.title: Cheonan Sizzling Beef Bulgogi & Suyuk Dinner
schedule.detail: Feast on tender seasoned beef bulgogi with fresh seasonal banchan side dishes.

blocks.label: 90-Year Culinary Lineage
blocks.text: Hakhwa Hodu-gwaja has baked Korea's most iconic train snack continuously since 1934.

blocks.label: Authentic Market Value
blocks.text: Namsan Central Market serves authentic knife-cut noodles at unbeatable traditional pricing.

days.food: Lunch: 1934 Hakhwa freshly baked warm walnut pastries & tea. Afternoon: Namsan Market handmade dumplings & kalguksu. Dinner: Cheonan charcoal-grilled Hanwoo beef bulgogi.

days.costNote: KTX ticket ~₩14,100; Hodu-gwaja box ~₩6,000; Market snacks ~₩8,000.
days.watchouts: Taste both the white bean paste (Baekang) and red bean paste variants of Hakhwa Hodu-gwaja for comparison.
days.planB: Hakhwa bakery and Namsan Central Market are fully enclosed and weatherproof.

days.title: Korea's Famous Blood Sausage Capital & Radiant Autumn Foliage
days.anchor: Byeongcheon Soondae Alley (50-Year Lineage) → Aunae Traditional Market → Independence Hall Autumn Walk

schedule.title: Independence Hall of Korea & Autumn Maple Walk
schedule.detail: Tour the colossal Grand Hall of the Nation and stroll the 3.2km Maple Tree Tunnel under golden autumn foliage.

schedule.detail: Feast on authentic Byeongcheon Soondae Gukbap: tender small intestine stuffed with cellophane noodles, fresh cabbage, leeks, and pork blood simmered in rich bone broth, served with steaming sliced soondae and pork cuts.

schedule.title: Aunae Traditional Marketplace Walk
schedule.detail: Stroll the historic marketplace, sampling traditional honey candy, puffed rice grains, and dried jujubes.

schedule.title: Return to Cheonan & Rest
schedule.detail: Relax at hotel or explore local cafes in Shinbu-dong.

schedule.title: Cheonan Charcoal Pork BBQ Dinner
schedule.detail: Feast on thick pork neck and steaming kimchi stew.

blocks.label: National Soondae Benchmark
blocks.text: Byeongcheon Soondae is nationally distinct for its heavy vegetable content and delicate, non-greasy flavor.

blocks.label: Historic Market Soul
blocks.text: Aunae Market preserves the historic spirit of Korea's 1919 independence movement.

days.food: Lunch: Famous Byeongcheon Soondae Gukbap (authentic pork blood sausage soup with assorted meats). Dinner: Shinbu-dong charcoal-grilled pork barbecue with soybean paste stew.
days.reservationNote: Independence Hall of Korea is free admission; closed on Mondays (outdoor grounds remain open).
days.costNote: Soondae lunch ~₩10,000; Dinner ~₩25,000 per person.
days.watchouts: Season soondae soup with salted shrimp (saeujeot) and red pepper paste (dadeagi) at your table.
days.planB: Byeongcheon restaurants and Independence Hall galleries are fully indoor.

days.title: Artisanal Fruit Wines, Living Fermentation & Royal Crossroad Pavilions

schedule.detail: Visit a local brewery crafting traditional Korean rice wine (makgeolli) and fruit wines made with famous sweet Cheonan Seonghwan pears.

blocks.label: Living Fermentation Heritage

days.costNote: Tasting ~₩15,000; Hanwoo dinner ~₩45,000 per person.
days.watchouts: Seonghwan pear wine bottles make wonderful boxed souvenirs.
days.planB: Brewery tasting rooms and restaurants are fully indoor.

blocks.label: Scenic Balance

schedule.title: Namsan Market Handmade Dumpling & Noodle Lunch

schedule.title: 1934 Hakhwa Hodu-gwaja Gift Curation
schedule.detail: Pick up sealed gift boxes of authentic walnut cakes for friends and family.

schedule.title: Hotel Packing & KTX Ticket Check
schedule.detail: Pack primary luggage for Friday morning KTX to coastal Busan and verify seat assignments.

schedule.detail: Celebrate 5 nights in Cheonan with rich pork galbi barbecue.

blocks.label: Artisan Pantry Curation
blocks.text: Freshly pressed perilla oil and roasted sesame seeds from traditional markets are incomparable culinary gifts.

blocks.label: Pre-Busan Preparation
blocks.text: Packing early ensures a relaxed Friday morning high-speed train directly to Busan.

schedule.title: KTX High-Speed Rail to Busan
schedule.detail: Smooth 1-hour 45-minute direct journey from Cheonan-Asan to Busan Station on the southern sea.

schedule.detail: Crispy golden fried chicken in Haeundae.

blocks.label: Intangible Cultural Asset
blocks.text: Dongnae Pajeon was historically presented to Joseon kings and is distinct from ordinary flat jeon.

blocks.label: Designated Folk Wine
blocks.text: Geumjeongsanseong Makgeolli is Korea's most historic artisanal rice wine.

days.food: Lunch: Dongnae Halmae Pajeon (royal scallion seafood pancake) paired with Geumjeongsanseong Makgeolli. Dinner: Haeundae gourmet fried chicken with honey garlic sauce.
days.reservationNote: Dongnae Halmae Pajeon is closed on Mondays; open Tuesday through Sunday.
days.costNote: Dongnae Pajeon lunch ~₩25,000 per person; Makgeolli ~₩5,000 bottle.
days.watchouts: Dongnae Pajeon has a soft, tender, pudding-like center from rice flour and egg; this is traditional authenticity.
days.planB: Dongnae Pajeon restaurant and Oncheonjang spa are fully indoor.

days.title: Korea's Marine Epicenter & Vibrant Night Street Eats
days.anchor: Jagalchi Fish Market Giant Seafood Feast → Bupyeong Kkangtong Night Market

schedule.title: Jagalchi Fish Market Giant Seafood Banquet
schedule.detail: Pick live King Crab, Snow Crab, or live octopus (san-nakji) from 1F stalls and have it steamed and prepared immediately on 2F with crab-roe fried rice.

schedule.title: BIFF Square Snack Crawl
schedule.detail: Taste original seed hotteok (crispy brown sugar pancake filled with sunflower seeds and pine nuts) and spicy rice cake skewers.

schedule.title: Gamcheon Culture Village Sunset Walk
schedule.detail: Stroll colorful hillside alleys and photograph the pastel harbor vistas.

schedule.title: Bupyeong Kkangtong Night Market Feasting
schedule.detail: Sample iconic night market street dishes: Bibim Dangmyeon (glass noodles with spicy seasoning), giant fried Busan fishcakes (Eomuk), skewered grilled pork, and rolled egg omelets.

blocks.label: Seafood Epicenter
blocks.text: Jagalchi is the largest and most legendary marine market in East Asia.

blocks.label: Street Food Variety
blocks.text: Bupyeong Kkangtong is Korea's first official permanent night street food market.

days.food: Lunch: Jagalchi Market steamed giant king crab with fried rice in crab carapace and seafood stew. Dinner: Bupyeong Kkangtong Night Market bibim dangmyeon, Samjin fishcakes, and street snacks.
days.reservationNote: Market stalls are cash / T-Money preferred; cards accepted in 2F restaurants.
days.costNote: King Crab lunch ~₩55,000–₩75,000 per person; Night market ~₩18,000.
days.watchouts: Crab prices are seasonal by weight; negotiate price before cooking.
days.planB: Jagalchi building and Bupyeong market are covered arcade facilities.

days.title: Steamed Coastal Snow Crabs & Oceanic Porridge Cauldron
days.anchor: Gijang Snow Crab Market → Yeonhwa-ri Abalone Porridge Village

schedule.title: Gijang Market Live Snow Crab Feast
schedule.detail: Select live Russian snow crabs and red king crabs from steaming wooden cedar boxes in Gijang market, served with rich crab-butter fried rice.
schedule.logistics: Donghae Line to Gijang Station or 25-min taxi from Haeundae.

schedule.title: Yeonhwa-ri Coastal Tent Village & Sea-View Cafe
schedule.detail: Stroll past the scenic orange and red lighthouses and enjoy coffee at a modern oceanfront cafe in Gijang.

schedule.title: Ananti Cove Ocean Promenade
schedule.detail: Relax along the coastal cliffs of Osiria tourism complex.

schedule.title: Yeonhwa-ri Abalone Porridge (Jeonbok-juk) Cauldron
schedule.detail: Dine on thick, emerald-green abalone porridge simmered with whole abalone entrails and sesame oil in a massive cast iron pot.

blocks.label: Gijang Snow Crab Authority
blocks.text: Gijang is Korea's premier East Sea snow crab distribution hub, offering peak freshness and direct wholesale value.

blocks.label: Abalone Intestine Porridge
blocks.text: True Busan jeonbok-juk is emerald green from the fresh abalone liver (geu), imparting deep oceanic umami.

days.food: Lunch: Gijang Market freshly steamed snow crab with seasoned crab-roe rice. Dinner: Yeonhwa-ri traditional abalone porridge (jeonbok-juk) in a cast iron pot.
days.reservationNote: Gijang market vendors offer steaming service included with crab purchase.
days.costNote: Snow crab lunch ~₩50,000–₩70,000 per person; Abalone porridge ~₩15,000 per person.
days.watchouts: Abalone porridge is cooked fresh to order in cauldrons; allow 20 mins preparation time.
days.planB: Gijang crab restaurants and Ananti complexes are comfortable and indoor.

days.title: Boiling Pork Bone Cauldrons & Atmospheric Orange Tents
days.anchor: Songjeong 3-dae Dwaeji Gukbap Alley → Seomyeon Pojangmacha Street Tents

schedule.title: Songjeong 3-dae Gukbap (Since 1946)
schedule.detail: Savor authentic Busan Dwaeji Gukbap: 24-hour simmered milky pork bone broth loaded with tender pork shoulder, spicy seasoned chives (buchu), and fermented saeujeot shrimp.

schedule.title: Seomyeon Youth Street & Cafe Alleys (Jeonpo-dong)
schedule.detail: Explore transformed tool-workshop cafes, artisan dessert bakeries, and specialty matcha shops in Jeonpo.

schedule.title: Centum City Spa Land Thermal Soak
schedule.detail: Relax and detox in 18 mineral spring pools before evening street feasting.

schedule.title: Seomyeon Pojangmacha (Orange Street Tents) Night
schedule.detail: Dine under iconic orange street tents: sizzling grilled pork belly, spicy stir-fried octopus, fishcake broth, and soju.
schedule.logistics: Lotte Department Store Seomyeon back alley.

blocks.label: 70-Year Soup Lineage
blocks.text: Songjeong 3-dae is Busan's most celebrated pork soup institution, bubbling continuously since 1946.

blocks.label: Cinematic Street Tents
blocks.text: Pojangmacha street tents represent Korea's most atmospheric night dining tradition.

days.food: Lunch: Songjeong 3-dae Dwaeji Gukbap (pork soup with suyuk boiled pork). Afternoon: Jeonpo artisan pastry & coffee. Dinner: Seomyeon Pojangmacha street tents (grilled spam, eggs, spicy octopus, and soju).
days.reservationNote: Songjeong 3-dae Gukbap is open 24 hours.
days.costNote: Gukbap lunch ~₩9,500; Pojangmacha dinner ~₩22,000 per person.
days.watchouts: Pojangmacha street tents are cash or bank transfer preferred.
days.planB: Seomyeon underground shopping mall and Gukbap restaurants are completely indoor.

days.title: Panoramic Ocean Teahouses & Clam Stew (CSAT / Suneung Day)
days.anchor: Dalmaji Hill Sea-View Teahouses → Cheongsapo Clam Stew (CSAT Day)

schedule.title: Dalmaji Hill Scenic Coastal Walk
schedule.detail: Gentle stroll along pine-covered Dalmaji Hill overlooking the sparkling Korea Strait.
schedule.logistics: Walk from Haeundae or short taxi.

schedule.title: Cheongsapo Seafood Stew & Grilled Fish Lunch
schedule.detail: Enjoy boiling seafood casserole (haemultang) packed with blue crab, prawns, squid, and clams.

schedule.title: Traditional Korean Tea & Rice Cake Atelier
schedule.detail: Sip artisanal green tea from Boseong and fermented plum tea accompanied by freshly steamed rainbow rice cakes (mujigae-tteok).

schedule.title: Busan Farewell Feast: Hanwoo Beef Short Ribs
schedule.detail: Celebrate 7 unforgettable Busan nights with charcoal-grilled marinated Hanwoo beef short ribs and cold naengmyeon noodles.

blocks.label: Low-Stakes CSAT Harmony
blocks.text: Nov 19 national exam day is spent peacefully in Haeundae and Dalmaji without city transit friction.

blocks.label: Epicurean Finale
blocks.text: Haeundae's legendary beef short ribs provide the ultimate culinary celebration in Busan.

days.food: Lunch: Cheongsapo bubbling seafood casserole (haemultang). Afternoon: Traditional plum tea & rice cakes. Dinner: Haeundae Somunnan Amso Galbi marinated beef short ribs with potato noodles.
days.reservationNote: Book Haeundae Somunnan Amso Galbi table upon arrival or go at 17:30 to avoid wait.
days.costNote: Lunch ~₩20,000; Farewell Hanwoo dinner ~₩50,000 per person.
days.watchouts: Add potato noodles (gamja-sari) to the beef galbi pan for the authentic local finish.
days.planB: Dalmaji teahouses and Haeundae indoor restaurants provide full comfort.

days.title: Return to Capital & Charcoal Pork Belly Feast
days.anchor: Morning KTX Busan to Seoul → Mapo Aged Pork Belly Barbecue → Gwanghwamun Night Walk

schedule.title: Busan Station Departure
schedule.detail: Pick up Samjin Amook warm fishcake snacks at Busan Station concourse and board direct KTX.

schedule.title: KTX High-Speed Rail to Seoul
schedule.detail: 2-hour 15-minute smooth transit back to Seoul Station.

schedule.title: Seoul Station Hotel Check-in & Noodle Lunch
schedule.detail: Check into Seoul Station hotel and enjoy warm kalguksu or dumpling soup.

schedule.title: Gwanghwamun Square & Kyobo Gourmet Bookstore
schedule.detail: Explore Kyobo bookstore foodie cookbook section and stroll Gwanghwamun square.

schedule.title: Mapo Charcoal Aged Pork Belly (Samgyeopsal) Feast
schedule.detail: Savor thick-cut 14-day dry-aged pork belly grilled over oak charcoal, wrapped with aged kimchi, perilla leaves, and ssamjang.

blocks.label: Friday Departure Buffer
blocks.text: Arriving in Seoul on Friday guarantees 2 nights of relaxed dining and zero weekend travel stress.

blocks.label: Aged Pork Excellence
blocks.text: Seoul's aged pork belly restaurants represent masterclass butchery and table-side grilling.

days.food: Lunch: Busan Station Samjin Amook fishcakes + Seoul Station warm kalguksu. Dinner: Mapo 14-day dry-aged thick samgyeopsal pork belly with kimchi stew.
days.reservationNote: Book KTX Busan→Seoul 30 days in advance on Korail app.
days.costNote: KTX ticket ~₩59,800; Dinner ~₩28,000 per person.
days.watchouts: Friday afternoon KTX trains sell out fast; reserve morning departure.
days.planB: Lotte Mart and Seoul Station concourse are completely enclosed.

days.title: Gourmet Pantry Curation & Michelin Farewell Feast
days.anchor: Namdaemun Market Food Alley → Seoul Station Lotte Mart Gourmet Curation → Grand Farewell Hanwoo Banquet

schedule.title: Namdaemun Market Kalguksu & Hotteok Alleys
schedule.detail: Taste fresh vegetable hotteok (japchae hotteok) and enjoy handmade kalguksu with complimentary bibim naengmyeon.

schedule.title: Seoul Station Lotte Mart Mega Gourmet Curation
schedule.detail: Fill luggage with culinary treasures: toasted seasoned seaweed (gim), artisan gochujang, sesame oil, Korean snack boxes, and dried seafood with instant tax refund.
schedule.logistics: Lotte Mart 2F immediate tax refund counter.

schedule.title: Luggage Packing & Scale Verification
schedule.detail: Pack gourmet pantry items safely into luggage, weigh bags at hotel front desk, and complete online flight check-in.

schedule.title: Grand Culinary Finale: Charcoal Hanwoo Beef Banquet
schedule.detail: Celebrate the 21-night culinary odyssey with premium charcoal-grilled Korean Hanwoo beef tenderloin, cold naengmyeon, and fine Korean plum wine (maesil-ju).
schedule.logistics: Central Seoul premier Hanwoo dining room.

blocks.label: Culinary Souvenir Mastery
blocks.text: Curating authentic pantry essentials brings Korea's rich gastronomy home to your own kitchen.

blocks.label: Zero Departure Stress
blocks.text: Completing all shopping, packing, and online check-in by Saturday night ensures Sunday morning is 100% serene.

days.food: Lunch: Namdaemun Market japchae hotteok and hand-pulled kalguksu soup. Dinner: Grand Hanwoo charcoal beef banquet with Pyongyang cold noodles and maesil wine.
days.reservationNote: Complete online airline check-in 24 hours prior to Sunday 13:00 departure.
days.costNote: Gourmet souvenirs ~₩60,000–₩120,000; Grand Farewell Dinner ~₩50,000 per person.
days.watchouts: Pack liquid condiments (sesame oil, sauces) securely inside plastic bags in checked luggage.
days.planB: Shinsegae and Lotte underground arcades provide full rain-proof shopping.

days.title: Seamless Airport Rail & Farewell Korean Breakfast
days.anchor: AREX Non-Stop Express to ICN → Airport Korean Food Street Breakfast → Flight at 13:00

schedule.title: Hotel Checkout & AREX Express Boarding
schedule.detail: Check out of Seoul Station hotel and board direct AREX Non-Stop Express Train to Incheon Airport (43 mins).

schedule.title: AREX Express to ICN Terminal 1 / 2
schedule.detail: Smooth, direct airport train ride with reserved seating and dedicated luggage racks.
schedule.logistics: 43 min to T1 / 51 min to T2.

schedule.title: Airport Customs, Tax Refunds & Farewell Breakfast
schedule.detail: Drop luggage, clear security, collect tax refund cash, and enjoy a warm bowl of Korean abalone porridge or beef soup at ICN Korean Food Street.
schedule.logistics: Target arriving at departure gate by 12:20.

schedule.title: Boarding & Flight Departure at 13:00
schedule.detail: Board flight home after an extraordinary 22-day culinary journey across South Korea.

blocks.label: Precision Logistics
blocks.text: Direct AREX express from Seoul Station guarantees exact, predictable airport arrival at 10:15.

blocks.label: Relaxed Departure
blocks.text: Ample time for tax refunds, duty-free pickup, and a comforting farewell meal before boarding.

days.food: Breakfast: ICN Airport Korean Food Street (warm abalone porridge or beef seolleongtang soup).
days.reservationNote: Verify your airline departure terminal (T1 vs T2) before boarding AREX.
days.costNote: AREX Express ticket ₩13,000 per person (fare raised from ₩11,000; verified 2026).
days.watchouts: Terminal 2 is 8 minutes further on the AREX line than Terminal 1.
days.planB: If AREX express sells out, AREX all-stop commuter train runs every 8 minutes.
